title: Studies on Annual Mortality and Cost Associated with Air Pollution from Human Activities
what_it_is: Studies on Annual Mortality and Cost Associated with Air Pollution from Human Activities

sections.label: WHO air quality guidelines
sections.summary: The Ministry uses WHO air quality guidelines and health cost studies to formulate air pollution mitigation policies, but cannot give specific mortality or health cost figures for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: My Ministry takes into account the World Health Organization’s (WHO) air quality guidelines, as well as studies on the health costs of air pollution, to formulate air pollution mitigation policies to safeguard public health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As the studies differ in their methodologies and assumptions, we are unable to provide specific information on the annual mortality or health costs associated with air pollution in Singapore.

sections.label: No ICE cars by 2040
sections.summary: For vehicles, the policy is no more internal combustible engine cars by 2040.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For vehicles, we now have a policy of no more internal combustible engine (ICE) cars by 2040, for instance.

sections.label: Air quality standards progress
sections.summary: Singapore has not reached the PM2.5 standard in the Sustainable Singapore Blueprint 2015, nor PM10, though other pollutant standards are met.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: On progress to achieve the full air quality standards as in our Sustainable Singapore Blueprint 2015 – we have not quite reached the standard for PM2.5.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have achieved the standards for some of the other pollutants but not PM2.5 or PM10.

sections.label: Energy Efficiency Grant measures
sections.summary: The Government is committed to supporting energy-conservation efforts and has recently introduced new measures such as the Energy Efficiency Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
